integrity: The proof separates source premises from new deductions. Exact polynomial arithmetic is replayable from the bundled standard-library script; no numerical root experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicit homological action of the genus-19 handle monodromy and its canonical symplectic quotient. It does not determine pseudo-Anosov dilatation or a surface-level Anosov model, and it relies on the exact homology computation in arXiv:2610.02261v1.
title: A canonical Anosov quotient of the genus-19 BMY handle monodromy
